method.automatic: Same task goal, prompt versions and two serial loopback fixture requests; actual API, Goals, Planner and Worker. Each condition repeated three times.
method.long_history: Each role resumes the same deterministic synthetic history for three continuations per run. Three runs per condition. Native pi manages compaction and JSONL restoration.
method.production_worker_setting: unchanged; 64K is an experimental setting, not a new default
method.cache: Provider-managed shared warm cache; conditions alternated, no cache flush capability. Hit rate is sum(cacheRead)/sum(inputTotal), not an arithmetic mean.
method.usage: Unique physical provider requests, includes compaction and failed attempts; checked against platform canonical aggregation. No currency estimate.
